direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-05-rcs-28992-comentario-28966 | Second ICA transaction with repeated rows
direct_evidence.body:
## Second ICA transaction with repeated rows

https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-28992

**Environment:** Prod, ARDM_PRODUCTION.C163_ICA. Transaction 2609179959263358647, store 70300, POS 2, ticket 7781, 2026-09-17. ARDM_HEADER has 1 row.

| Table | Rows | Distinct content |
|---|---|---|
| ARDM_TENDER | 4 | 1 |
| ARDM_TRANSACTIONDISCOUNT | 32 | 8 |
| ARDM_ITEM | 38 | 37 |

Distinct content excludes RECORDSEQNO, INSERTEDDATETIME and UPDATEDDATETIME.

Claude proposed that this transaction follows the pattern in your comment of 2026-09-24. I ran the counts myself in Snowflake. My reading is that tender and discount rows repeat and the item table does not. Could someone evaluate this?

1. Does this transaction fall inside the scoped fix and the data correction?
2. Does ARDM_ITEM, with 37 distinct contents in 38 rows, fit the redelivery pattern?
3. How many copies of this receipt reached the raw layer?

Conversation outside the ticket: Teams chat with Viraj Kansara on 2026-10-05.

direct_evidence.body:
Que hace Enrique hoy.
1. Pega la nota interna de inbox/2026-10-05-rcs-28992-comentario-interno.md en la pestaña Internal note de Jira. Ahí queda escrito el vínculo con RCS-28966 que pidió Viraj.
2. Pega inbox/2026-10-05-rcs-28992-respuesta-peter.md en la pestaña de respuesta. Peter no tiene update desde el 18 sep.
3. Responde a Viraj con inbox/2026-10-05-rcs-28992-teams-viraj.md.
4. Corre inbox/2026-10-05-rcs-28992-verificacion.sql en Snowflake Prod. Si las filas salen repetidas con contenido idéntico, comenta los conteos en el ticket. Si salen 0 filas, pregunta a Bikash en RCS-28966 si el feed entregó ese recibo.

Precedentes.
RCS-28966 ICA, mismo feed y misma etiqueta, https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-28966
RCS-28751 Loblaw, snapshots repetidos sin dedup en insert 1:1, confluence/RTS-triage/RCS-28751-loblaw-sdm-item-discount-duplicados.md. Otro cliente, sostiene la hipótesis y no la confirma.

Compromisos. Enrique promete a Peter y a Shaun un update en el ticket tras confirmar los conteos. Sin fecha de arreglo.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-18-rcs-28992-respuesta-peter-just
direct_evidence.body:
Hi Peter, thank you for flagging this and for the screenshot, it is helpful to have the exact transaction ID to work from.

I looked into transaction 2609179959263358647 on my end and I am not seeing it come through in our processed data yet for that store. Rather than confirm anything about the tender records right now, I want to wait until that transaction lands so I am looking at the same thing you are.

I will check again once it shows up in our data and come back to you with what I find.

I appreciate everything you have sent over so far. I do not think I need anything else at the moment, and I will let you know as soon as I have an update.
